THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
TEXTURE IN MOTION
053
73 / Lace Back
Street Utility
A low, crouched studio pose in a black sleeveless top with a
corset-style lace-up back, a sage-green utility mini skirt with a
wide belt and tall black platform boots. Long dark hair falls over
one shoulder against a cool blue-grey backdrop.
74 / Velvet Rose
Event Velvet
A short black velvet dress with puffed, fitted sleeves, a sheer
illusion neckline trimmed in black, and flared cuffs. Hair pinned
into a high bun, with a single pale pink rose held low in front of
the body against a soft pink backdrop.
